title: 阶塔 · 潮痕信塔 · 回港章
title_note: 临时名可改。原创制作1–20层；21–50层未制作。

manifest.scope: Original fixed authored floors 1-20, not a completed fifty-floor game.

modes.practice: Explicit restoration of a complete captured checkpoint.

ev_mapper_exchange.text: 这枚缺角正好接上我的旧图。蓝钥匙归你：第五层的盐封档案门后，留着入塔队的行程。铜签我收好了，这次交换只有一把钥匙。

ev_mapper_intro.text: 我是岚绘。第三层索室有一枚缺角铜签；带回来，我用档案门的蓝钥匙换它。黄钥匙每层只够先开一条支路：刃路给攻击和余钱，护路给防御和清水。门不会自己关回去。

ev_copper.text: 铜签背面刻着半道潮线，和岚绘旧图上的缺口相合。带回第一层，或先继续探索；它不会自动变成钥匙。

ev_archive.text: 档案没有写下失踪者的结局，只留了一句：‘灯未熄，去第七层问守灯人。’匣中工具与水仍可用。你记下路线，取走这份一次性补给。

ev_keeper_supply.text: 你看过那份档案了。留下布结的人还在往上走；这袋水和修补钱原本为他留着，现在交给你。第十层信台能向塔外报平安，这不是整座塔的终点。

ev_keeper_intro.text: 我叫弥安。第五层的档案匣能说明那枚布结；若你还没看过，回去找找。我的补给只会交付一次。

ev_signal.text: 第一道信号已经照向塔外。现在可沿桥梯继续探索第11–20层；第21–50层尚未制作。此处只是首章里程碑。
ev_signal.text_en: The first signal reaches the outside. The bridge now continues through authored floors 11-20; floors 21-50 are not made. This is the first-chapter milestone, not the tower's end.

ev_c2_first_blue.text: 潮尺数值与墨印合上了。给你一把蓝钥匙，开第14层回访蓝闸。这次交换只有一次；黄钥匙仍要留给前行黄闸。
ev_c2_first_blue.text_en: The gauge and ink seal agree. Take one blue key for the return-visit sluice on F14. This exchange happens once; keep yellow keys for the forward gates.

ev_c2_surveyor_intro.text: 我是砾舟。读第12层潮尺、取第13层墨印，再来换蓝钥匙。本层黄钥匙要开下一层的前行闸；支匣只有补给，没有替代钥匙。现在开支匣，会把前行钥匙花掉。
ev_c2_surveyor_intro.text_en: I am Lizhou. Read the F12 gauge and bring the F13 ink seal back for a blue key. This floor's yellow key is needed by the forward gate on F12. The side cache contains supplies, not a replacement key; opening it now spends the key needed to continue.

ev_c2_scale.text: 潮尺留下的刻度需要第13层墨印校验。把两条证据带回第11层砾舟处；前行黄闸仍须实付一把钥匙。
ev_c2_scale.text_en: The gauge reading needs the F13 ink seal. Bring both findings back to Lizhou on F11. The forward yellow gate still costs one real key.

ev_c2_ink.text: 你取下未褪色的墨印。它不是钥匙；第11层的测量员能用它和潮尺读数完成交换。
ev_c2_ink.text_en: You recover the unfaded ink seal. It is not a key. The surveyor on F11 can exchange the seal together with the gauge reading.

ev_c2_register.text: 外柜路簿写着第16层绮线的补给安排。你取走登记过的工具和清水：攻击+3、防御+3、生命+80。蓝闸是上行通道，与这个外柜各自保留状态。
ev_c2_register.text_en: The outer register records Qixian's supplies on F16. Collect the listed tools and water: +3 ATK, +3 DEF, +80 HP. The blue sluice is the way upward; it and this outer counter keep their own persistent state.

ev_c2_f11_cache.text: 补给匣交付生命+90、金币+30。匣里没有黄钥匙；第12层前行闸仍需一把黄钥匙。
ev_c2_f11_cache.text_en: The cache grants +90 HP and +30 gold. It contains no yellow key; the forward gate on F12 still needs one.

ev_c2_f15_cache.text: 应急匣交付生命+110、金币+40，没有返还钥匙。本层黄钥匙与前行闸共用；后面的钥匙源位于闸后。
ev_c2_f15_cache.text_en: The emergency cache grants +110 HP and +40 gold, without returning the key. It shares this floor's key with the forward gate. Later key sources are beyond that gate.

ev_c2_second_blue.text: 双潮印对应的是第19层蓝闸。给你一把蓝钥匙，无法重复领取；第20层前行黄闸仍需要另外保留的黄钥匙。
ev_c2_second_blue.text_en: The twin-tide seal matches the blue sluice on F19. Take one blue key, once only. The forward yellow gate on F20 still needs a separately reserved yellow key.

ev_c2_rigger_supply.text: 按路簿交付额外黄钥匙一把、生命+40。这把额外钥匙可在第17层刃匣与第19层储备匣之间选一；其余前行钥匙别挪作支路。第18层找到双潮印，再来换第19层蓝钥匙。
ev_c2_rigger_supply.text_en: The register authorizes one extra yellow key and +40 HP. This extra key can choose the F17 edge cache or the F19 reserve cache. Do not spend the other forward-gate keys on side rooms. Bring the F18 twin-tide seal back for the F19 blue key.

ev_c2_rigger_intro.text: 我是绮线。先读第14层外柜路簿，才能领取额外钥匙和清水；它仍在可回访的楼层。
ev_c2_rigger_intro.text_en: I am Qixian. Read the outer register on F14 before collecting the extra key and water. That earlier floor remains available to revisit.

ev_c2_plan.text: 镜向图标出回港信号的校准次序。你记下它，供第20层校准器使用。此处只是一层四邻平面回廊，不是可重叠通行的桥。
ev_c2_plan.text_en: The mirror plan records the beacon's calibration order. Keep it for the alignment instrument on F20. The causeway is one ordinary four-neighbor floor; it has no stacked crossing cells.

ev_c2_edge_cache.text: 刃匣交付攻击+5。这花掉一把黄钥匙；若使用的是额外那把，后面的前行钥匙预算仍可保留，但第19层储备匣就不能兼得。
ev_c2_edge_cache.text_en: The edge cache grants +5 ATK for one yellow key. Spending the extra key keeps the later forward-gate budget intact, but leaves no spare key for the F19 reserve cache.

ev_c2_sigil.text: 你取得双潮印。回第16层交给绮线，才能获得第19层蓝钥匙；印本身不打开门。
ev_c2_sigil.text_en: You recover the twin-tide seal. Return it to Qixian on F16 for the blue key to F19. The seal itself does not open a door.

ev_c2_reserve_cache.text: 储备匣交付生命+80、防御+2。它消耗一把黄钥匙；第20层前行闸仍须留下最后一把。
ev_c2_reserve_cache.text_en: The reserve cache grants +80 HP and +2 DEF for one yellow key. Keep the final yellow key for the forward gate on F20.

ev_c2_alignment.text: 镜向图与双潮印都已齐备。校准器记住本局的设置；打开前行闸后，才可点亮回港镜台。
ev_c2_alignment.text_en: The mirror plan and twin-tide seal are both recorded. The instrument stores this run's alignment. The return beacon can be lit after opening the forward gate.

ev_c2_signal.text: 第二道信号接通回港航线。原创1–20层切片完成，仍可回访与保存；第21–50层尚未制作，这不是整塔通关。
ev_c2_signal.text_en: The second signal reconnects the return route. The authored 1-20 slice is complete and remains open to revisit and save. Floors 21-50 are not made; the fifty-floor campaign is not complete.

rules_assumptions: finite fixed resources and shop stock
all geometry and encounters fixed at build time
NPC and event rewards once only
floor 10 is a chapter milestone; floor 20 is the authored slice milestone; neither is fifty-floor campaign victory
one logical four-neighbor layer per floor; no stacked height physics

provenance.layout: Floors 1-9 copied unchanged from the frozen original slice; floor 10 has only the necessary bridge/milestone adaptation; floors 11-20 newly authored.
provenance.story_and_dialogue: New original chapter-2 Chinese and English writing, no copied commercial dialogue

journal_entries.text: F3缺角铜签带回F1，换取首章档案蓝钥匙。
journal_entries.text_en: Bring the F3 copper tag back to F1 for the first-chapter archive's blue key.

journal_entries.text: 读F5档案，去F7领取守灯人一次补给。
journal_entries.text_en: Read the F5 archive, then collect the lightkeeper's one-time supplies on F7.

journal_entries.text: 读F12潮尺、取F13墨印，回F11换蓝钥匙。
journal_entries.text_en: Read the F12 gauge, take the F13 ink seal, and return to F11 for the blue key.

journal_entries.text: 读F14外柜路簿，再找F16绮线领一次额外黄钥匙。
journal_entries.text_en: Read the F14 outer register, then collect Qixian's one extra yellow key on F16.
Bring the F18 twin-tide seal back to F16 for the F19 blue key.

journal_entries.text: 保存最后一把黄钥匙，校准并点亮F20镜台。
journal_entries.text_en: Reserve the last yellow key, align the instrument and light the F20 beacon.
